environmentVariables.description: 12-word BIP-39 phrase for the blind vault. Optional: without it the server works exactly as before. With it, sealed:true encrypts a memory on your machine and computes its search vector here, so sealed memories can still be found, and searches send the query's vector instead of its text. Generate one with chainmemory_new_seed. It never leaves your machine and cannot be recovered.

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let get_project_brief return the FULL level (addresses, ports, server paths and security rules) when you ask for it. Leave it empty to keep every brief at the public level, which is safe to paste anywhere. Works only with the owner's key, and ChainMemory logs every full-level request.
environmentVariables.name: CHAINMEMORY_ALLOW_FULL

environmentVariables.description: NOT NEEDED for normal use — leave it empty. Only the chainmemory_seal tool reads it, to sign a contract call yourself instead of letting the API anchor the memory (which chainmemory_remember already does). If you do set it, it is a wallet private key: use a dedicated wallet holding only a few AIC, never your main one. No other tool uses it.
environmentVariables.name: AICHAIN_KEY

environmentVariables.description: RPC endpoint used only by chainmemory_seal (default: https://rpc.chainmemory.ai). Leave it empty unless you set AICHAIN_KEY.

server.description: Washington property evidence and transaction math for agents in Claude, ChatGPT and AI apps.

headers.description: Optional for clients that sign in with OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT). Otherwise 'Bearer agk_...'; start a free 7-day trial (no card) and get a key at https://sentineliq.net/mcp.
headers.name: Authorization

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.io.sentineliq/attribution: Responses carry an 'attributions' array; entries marked required:true (Pierce County, Whatcom County, Redfin) must be reproduced wherever the data is displayed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NWMLS, the Washington Department of Revenue, or any county.

io.sentineliq/coverage.note: Property records cover four Washington counties only. The REET and net-sheet calculators know local rates for eleven counties; that is a rate table, not data coverage.

keyed.auth: OAuth 2.1 sign-in (PKCE, dynamic or metadata-document client registration) or Authorization: Bearer agk_...
keyed.limits: 60 requests/minute per key; 2000 served answers per rolling 24h per account
keyed.pricing: Free 7-day trial with no card (sign up at https://sentineliq.net/mcp), then Sentinel Connect at $29/month for agents or an integration pilot for developers

io.sentineliq/not_included: Independent field-by-field verification of historical building attributes is not available. Cached values may include earlier enrichment; preserve interior_provenance_status and provenance_note. Known portal backfills are omitted.
Owner and taxpayer names, mailing addresses, owner-status classification, and equity estimates are not included in this version.

Listing links, photos and portal automated valuations are absent. Status, price and related fields are available only for a matched licensed listing already on file; null means no licensed listing on file.
No bulk export, batch endpoint, or area enumeration; every property lookup is per-address.
No lead, distress, delinquency, foreclosure, probate, or court signals. Permit coverage is limited to the connected jurisdictions named in each response and never proves an absence of permits.
No skip trace, phone or email append, or contact lookup.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.io.sentineliq/read_only: Tools do not change customer records or send messages. Successful keyed answers update the account usage ledger.
